messages:
maya: Heads up — tokenstack dashboard is showing some routes with NEGATIVE cache savings this morning. Not a UI bug; numbers drive downstream billing.
alex: uh oh. which routes? example? :eyes:
maya: route: `/v1/predict/nlp-redirect` — cache savings column is -$0.07 per 1000 invocations for a 3-hour window.
sam: that usually means double-counting of prefetch vs hotpath credits or a stale prefetched KV blob. did you filter by model sku?
maya: yes. I sliced by model_sku=redwood-xl-8 and tenant=acme-inc. SQL I used:
```
SELECT route, sum(token_cost) as tokens, sum(cache_credit) as cache
FROM tokenlineage
WHERE window >= '2026-03-20T00:00:00Z' AND model_sku='redwood-xl-8'
GROUP BY route
```
jordan: hunch: our `cache_credit` is negative when we apply the "sticky cache credit" amortization twice — once at the prefetch pass and once at the batch attribution step. 
alex: makes sense — we added an amortize step in the router last week (PR #4572) to prefer dedicated capacity, might be interacting with the prefetch pipeline.
sam: is this observable in trace logs? we should check per-request lineage. ops-bot: deployed tracing patch for tokenlineage last night — sample rate 0.5%.
maya: traces I grabbed show two credits: one attributed to prefetch and one to hotpath, but only one should win.
alex: quick mitigation: change UI to floor cache savings at 0 in the widget until we fix attribution? but that hides real negative cases.
jordan: I'd prefer a guarded floor in the public dashboard plus an internal flag that surfaces routes with negative effective cache (for eng only).
sam: agree. Also: telemetry change — increase lineage sampling from 0.5% to 5% for routes with >5000 rps for the next 6 hours so we can repro more traces.
maya: i'm +1 to sampling bump. can someone own the console patch to add the internal-only column?
alex: I can PR the UI change (floor + show-internal). Will add a tooltip: "negative values flagged — internal diagnostics available".
jordan: I'll open a backend ticket to audit amortization steps and add a unit test in the token-attributor. Ticket: INF-2149.
sam: for the routing policy side, if the router is triggering prefetches against the new dedicated capacity logic we should add a guard: prefetch credits are only applied if the prefetch source is on the same pool as hotpath in the last N minutes. otherwise skip amortization.
maya: good idea. that reduces cross-pool double attribution. can we sketch the pseudo?
jordan: pseudo:
```
if prefetch.pool == last_hotpath.pool or time_since_last_hotpath < 5m:
  apply_prefetch_credit()
else:
  apply_prefetch_credit(0)
```
alex: also want to avoid breaking rollouts. this can be rolled out as a feature flag: `prefetch_pool_guard` default off for 24h, then enable for 10% traffic, watch econ panel.
sam: add a cost dashboard alert rule: when any route's cache_savings_per_1k < -0.01 for 3 consecutive windows -> fire pager to #eng-platform (low severity).
maya: I'll add the alert in console. also want to add a breakdown column: `credit_sources` (list of sources and amounts) in the internal view.
ops-bot: action logged — created internal task INF-2149 (jordan). Tracing sample increased to 5% for flagged routes.
maya: thanks. timeline? alex — UI PR ETA?
alex: aiming EOD for the guarded floor + internal view PR. will leave toggles behind a launchdarkly flag.
jordan: backend audit first pass tomorrow morning. I'll include a small repro harness to simulate prefetch/hotpath overlap.
sam: once we have repro, we should run the econ simulation to check per-model unit economics across the affected routes — especially combinations where quantized models share the same KV cache.
maya: agree. follow-ups: 1) alex UI PR, 2) jordan backend ticket + unit tests, 3) sam run econ sim, 4) maya create console alert + internal column.
jordan: tagging @alex @sam @maya so we can sync on standup. :thumbsup:
alex: cool. i'll post the PR link in this thread when ready. :rocket:
